# Stone Aspen Signature Builders (concept by Kerblabs)

> Owner-led custom home and detached living builder in Castle Rock, Colorado, serving Douglas County and South Denver. Facts from stoneaspen.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Mailing address: Stone Aspen, LLC, PO Box 1626, Castle Rock, CO 80104
- Phone / text: 303-656-0972 (Brian Putnam, Owner/Builder, as listed on their contact page)
- Contact form: https://www.stoneaspen.com/contact
- Email: none published

## Services
- Custom homes
- Accessory dwelling units (ADUs)
- Detached living spaces: guest houses, home offices, studios, gyms, golf simulator rooms, workshops, hobby spaces, pool houses

## Service area
Castle Rock, Parker, Franktown, Sedalia, Littleton, Greenwood Village, Cherry Hills Village, Elizabeth, Monument (Douglas County and South Denver)

## FAQ
- Where? Douglas County and South Denver, CO.
- Prices? Not published in the source pages. Their site offers a design questionnaire (custom homes) and an ADU project questionnaire.
